brand.name: Bikester Global
brand.description: Bikester Global is a Mumbai-based riding gear retailer with walk-in stores across the city, stocking ECE/DOT certified helmets and riding gear from LS2, Crank1 and other established brands, alongside touring luggage and bike accessories.

stores.name: Bikester Global - Malad
address_lines: Gala 4, Shakti Textile, Chincholi Bunder Rd
next to TATA Motors, Ram Nagar
stores.landmark: next to Tata Motors on Chincholi Bunder Road
stores.intro: Bikester Global Malad sits right on Chincholi Bunder Road, next to Tata Motors — an easy stop whether you're cutting through on the Link Road or coming off the Western Express Highway. Walk in for ECE and DOT certified full-face and modular helmets, riding jackets, gloves, boots and touring luggage from LS2, Crank1 and other brands riders already trust. Every helmet gets test-fitted on your head at the counter — we don't sell you a size off a chart.

quotes.name: Sushmita Das (VStromCouple)
quotes.text: Just like you have a favourite restaurant for your hunger cravings, every rider has that one go-to place for bike gear and accessories. For us, it's Bikester Global. They have a great range of saddle bags, fog lights, riding jackets, boots, mounts and other essential riding gear. What makes the experience even better is the support from Abdul and Ali — they're always there to guide you and recommend the best-suited products for both you and your motorcycle, based on real riding needs.

quotes.name: Aatif Shaikh
quotes.text: I had an amazing experience with this team! Their service was top-notch, and everything was handled smoothly even remotely.

quotes.name: Soumya Panda
quotes.text: Got the tarmac riding jacket and other products. All are genuine and I am happy with the service.

quotes.name: Shreesh Melmani
quotes.text: This is best shop for buying bike accessories — if you are looking for any bike accessories please do visit over here.

localities.name: Kandivali West
localities.blurb: Riders from Kandivali West usually reach us via SV Road or the Link Road flyover, cutting past Charkop and Poisar Depot. It's a straight run down Chincholi Bunder Road once you're past the Malad signal — the store is on your left, right next to the Tata Motors showroom. Handy stop if you're commuting daily on the Link Road corridor and want your helmet fitted properly instead of ordering a guessed size online.

localities.name: Goregaon West
localities.blurb: Goregaon West — Oberoi Mall, Aarey Road, Link Road — is barely ten minutes from the Malad store. A lot of our Goregaon regulars ride down on their lunch break to swap a scratched visor or pick up gloves before a weekend trip. Chincholi Bunder Road connects straight through, no real traffic snarl between the two.

localities.name: Orlem
localities.blurb: Orlem is practically next door — five minutes from the Orlem Church junction down Chincholi Bunder Road. If you're around Mith Chowki or Liberty Garden and your helmet strap just gave up, it's faster to walk in than to order online and wait.

localities.name: Marve Road
localities.blurb: If you're based along Marve Road and riding out toward Aksa or Madh Island on weekends, swing by the Malad store first — get your helmet's visor and ventilation checked before a long ride, not after. It's a short, straight hop down to Chincholi Bunder Road.

localities.name: Kandivali East
localities.blurb: From Kandivali East — Thakur Village, Poisar — the ride down is via the Western Express Highway service road or the Link Road flyover, roughly 15-20 minutes depending on the signal at Malad. Worth the trip if you want to physically compare an LS2 full-face against a modular before deciding, rather than guess from photos.

faqs.q: Does the Malad store stock ISI and DOT certified helmets?
faqs.a: Yes. Every helmet sold is ISI marked as required by Indian law, with ECE and DOT certified options from LS2 and other brands across full-face, modular and open-face styles.

faqs.q: Can I try on jackets, gloves and boots before buying?
faqs.a: Yes — walk in and test-fit anything in-store. Sizing isn't identical across brands, so we fit you at the counter instead of you guessing a size online.

faqs.q: Where exactly is the store located?
faqs.a: Gala 4, Shakti Textile, Chincholi Bunder Road, right next to the Tata Motors showroom in Malad West. Tap "Get Directions" above for turn-by-turn navigation.

faqs.q: Can I check if a specific helmet or size is in stock before I come?
faqs.a: Call or WhatsApp us the brand, model and size and we'll confirm stock before you ride down.

stores.name: Bikester Global - Santacruz
stores.landmark: on VM Bhargav Road, Santacruz West
stores.intro: Bikester Global Santacruz is tucked into VM Bhargav Road in Santacruz West, a short ride off SV Road — easy to reach for riders across the western suburbs corridor from Vile Parle down to Bandra. The shop carries ECE and DOT certified helmets, riding jackets, gloves, boots and touring luggage from LS2, Crank1 and other established names, with every helmet test-fitted before you buy.

localities.name: Vile Parle West
localities.blurb: Vile Parle West riders — including the college crowd around Parle campuses — usually come down SV Road, a straight eight-minute ride to VM Bhargav Road. A regular stop for first-time riders picking their first ISI-marked helmet.

localities.name: Khar West
localities.blurb: Khar West is one of the closest localities to the Santacruz store — down Linking Road and a quick cut onto VM Bhargav Road, under ten minutes on a normal traffic day. Handy for a fast in-and-out gear check between errands.

localities.name: Bandra West
localities.blurb: From Bandra West — Linking Road, Turner Road, Pali Hill — it's about ten to twelve minutes down to Santacruz, mostly along Linking Road itself. A common stop for riders upgrading from a stock helmet to a proper ECE-rated one before longer highway runs.

localities.name: Andheri West
localities.blurb: Andheri West riders coming down SV Road hit some signal traffic near Vile Parle, so budget closer to fifteen minutes. Worth it if you want to physically compare glove and boot sizes across brands rather than order two sizes online and return one.

faqs.q: Does the Santacruz store stock ISI and DOT certified helmets?

faqs.q: Can I try on jackets, gloves and boots before buying?
faqs.a: Yes — walk in and test-fit anything in-store. Sizing isn't identical across brands, so we fit you at the counter instead of you guessing a size online.

localities.name: Majiwada
localities.blurb: Majiwada riders heading down toward the Ghodbunder Road flyover usually swing by Khopat first — traffic near the junction can stretch what's a short distance into a ten-minute ride. Worth planning around if you're heading further up Ghodbunder Road toward Bhiwandi.

localities.name: Vartak Nagar
localities.blurb: From Vartak Nagar, near the Eastern Express Highway junction, it's a quick run down to Khopat — handy if you're commuting on the EEH daily and want gear that actually fits instead of whatever was left on the shelf.

stores.name: Bikester Global - Navi Mumbai
address_lines: Shop No 7, Shree Om Sadguru CHS Ltd, Plot No 122
stores.intro: Bikester Global Navi Mumbai is in Sector 50 E, Seawoods West, Nerul, just off Palm Beach Road — closest to CBD Belapur, with Juinagar, Sanpada and Vashi riders a straightforward run up Palm Beach Road away. Stock includes ECE and DOT certified helmets, riding jackets, gloves, boots and touring luggage from LS2, Crank1 and other established brands, with every helmet fitted in-store before you buy.

quotes.name: Nikhil Narvekar
quotes.text: I had a great experience shopping at Bikester Global, Seawoods. I initially purchased a pair of riding gloves, but later needed to exchange them for another product. The store staff were extremely helpful and handled the entire exchange process smoothly and professionally, making it a completely hassle-free experience. The store offers a wide range of high-quality riding gear, and the team is knowledgeable, courteous, and customer-focused.

quotes.name: Rahul Lalwani
quotes.text: So Bikester Global just opened a store in Nerul, Navi Mumbai. In the city I live, landed on the opening day and was helped really well by Akash to choose the right gloves.

quotes.name: Yogesh Mutkiri
quotes.text: Great experience at Bikester Global Seawoods branch. I bought the LS2 Storm 2 and their executive Akash did an excellent job helping me find the best fit and best graphics.

quotes.name: Krish Patil
quotes.text: Great experience with great prices, very loving staff, helped out a lot — quite a lot of helmets, gloves and accessories available at great price. Loved it.

quotes.name: Saurabh K
quotes.text: Great shopping experience with Bikester Global. The product was genuine, staff is extremely helpful.

quotes.name: Shraval Gangurde
quotes.text: Awesome shop, variety of gears available, helpful and polite staff.

localities.name: CBD Belapur
localities.blurb: CBD Belapur is the closest business district to the Seawoods store — a straight run down Palm Beach Road, under ten minutes outside office rush hour. Handy for the Belapur business-district crowd swinging by after work to try on a jacket before deciding.

localities.name: Juinagar
localities.blurb: Juinagar riders head down Palm Beach Road or the station-side service road to reach Seawoods, usually under twenty minutes outside peak hours. A regular stop for station-area commuters picking up gloves or a quick visor swap.

localities.name: Sanpada
localities.blurb: Sanpada riders usually come down Palm Beach Road, a longer but straightforward run to Seawoods with light traffic outside peak hours. A common stop for Palm Beach Road regulars wanting a well-ventilated helmet for the coastal stretch.

localities.name: Vashi
localities.blurb: From Vashi, down Palm Beach Road or the Sion-Panvel Highway service road, budget twenty to twenty-five minutes depending on the APMC market traffic. Worth the trip for riders comparing touring luggage — tank bags and saddle bags are easier to judge in person.
